Don't forget to set the status of the original puzzle contribution to Private.

Input
* Line 2: Please add "if Line 1 is {{None}}" after "0".

Constraints
* Please insert this as the third constraint:
0 ≤ [[prices]] ≤ 1000

Thanks.

Hello everyone,
This is the Clash of Code version of my puzzle “List It”. This idea was inspired by my own cravings and the delicious delicacies here in the Philippines. I hope you guys enjoy solving it and find it helpful for learning. Please feel free to share your feedback and suggestions — thank you so much for your time and continued support! ❤️
